decisions.reason: Confirmed false necessity assertions: exp(z) has m_0(r,fprime/f)=0 at every radius although transcendental. Revised Remarks state only sufficient finite-order and rational hypotheses for the logarithmic derivative, and explain that arbitrary S occurrences receive no such refinement. Also corrected the false denial of closure under finite real linear combinations, which follows from finite unions of exceptional sets. The Definition section is byte-for-byte unchanged; no consumer propagation.

The cited First Main Theorem assumes nonconstant h, but normalization of f(z)=cz^k produces h=1. Added the direct bound m_0(r,k/z)<=log^+|k| for this case and restricted the remaining proof and F3 to nonconstant h. Checked differentiated kernels, alpha-power angular integrability, nonnegative centre-free counts, and normalization; the Statement is unchanged.

N_1 is the integrated local-degree-minus-one count, whereas the truncated count is Nbar. A simple a-point contributes zero to N_1 and one to Nbar. Replaced the incorrect naming in Definition with the exact weighting. The formulas and the proof using N_1<=N and T tending to infinity remain valid.

F3 claimed a theorem for arbitrary holomorphic series that its power-series suppliers do not state. Restricted F3 to power series and wrote the lacunary sum as the ordinary coefficient series with a_j=r_n^(-lambda_n) at j=lambda_n and zero elsewhere. Absolute convergence on every disc gives infinite radius; the cited differentiation theorem now applies exactly. Checked the dominant derivative, summable tails, comparison quotient, and next-circle infinite-order estimate. This is nonfatal: the actual construction is already a sparse power series, so no stronger theorem or new prerequisite is needed.

The three power-map counts are correct, but increasing the right side of an SMT inequality from truncated to full counts preserves it. Replaced the false impossibility claim by this monotonicity caveat and retained the unbounded difference that prevents substituting Nbar for N in the First Main Theorem equality. Example formulas and all count calculations are unchanged.

The eventual bound T<=r^(rho+1) does not characterize exact order rho. Replaced F6 by the limsup definition, its eventual rho+eta bound, and the equivalence of finite order with log^+T=O(log r). Step 1.2 uses only that valid equivalence. Checked the Borel radius, alpha=1/2 application, chordal comparison and rational partial-fraction estimate; the Statement is unchanged.

False positive: the full supplier proof, lem-nevanlinna-exterior-three-value-extension steps 2.3-8.1, establishes chordal equicontinuity by Schottky and Cauchy estimates and extracts a convergent subsequence on a fixed annulus. Steps 8.2-10.1 propagate bounds on the function or reciprocal to obtain extension. The example applies that normal-family result by inversion and correctly handles finitely many preimages. Its title and claim are supported; no item edit is warranted.
